subject: MAP operational runbook — SOC2/SIG/DPA closure + retention escape hatches
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@pioneerhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-11T10:15:00-08:00
Subject: MAP draft and operational runbook — initial pass

Hi Sarah,

Following our call this morning, please find attached a first-pass MAP operational runbook (MAP-draft-v1.pdf). The doc focuses on the security/compliance gates we heard are critical for Pioneer: SOC 2 evidence, SIG/CAIQ scope, DPA wording for retention, and an acceptance checklist for the evaluation window.

Two asks to keep the lane moving:
- Could you confirm the SIG/CAIQ modules you want completed for the evaluation (auth, data protection, infra, etc.)? We put a conservative full-scope recommendation in the draft.
- Pioneer’s retention target: do you need a 90-day vs 180-day default for evaluation data, and are there any special residency constraints?

If possible we’d like to lock the acceptance criteria by Thursday so we can align the evidence sprint and a short SOC2 attestation mapping. Proposed quick timeline in the doc (week-by-week).

Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.pdf (runbook), quick-acceptance-table (inline)

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Head of Field Security Operations
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0198

From: Sarah Li <sarah.li@pioneerhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@pioneerhealth.com
Date: 2026-12-12T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft and operational runbook — initial pass

Kimberly —

Thanks for the draft and the clear timeline. A few quick clarifications from our side:

- SIG/CAIQ scope: we care most about Data Protection, Identity & Access Management, and System Security. Can you indicate which questions you plan to self-attest vs provide evidence for?
- Retention: for evaluation data we need a default 180-day retention, but we want a documented escape hatch if we need data kept longer for a clinical audit — that would be on a per-case basis with DPA addendum.
- SOC 2: Pioneer requires mapped evidence for the controls in CC6 and CC7 (change management and system operations). If you can outline the evidence owners and timelines that helps.

Attaching our SIG-scope doc with markings (Pioneer-SIG-scope.pdf). Looping in legal for the DPA retention language.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Li
Director, Platform Security
Pioneer Health
sarah.li@pioneerhealth.com

Date: 2026-12-13T14:40:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: evidence sprint checklist + technical gating notes (SOC2/SIG)

Kim, Naomi, Aditya —

Quick internal run-through based on Sarah’s SIG carveouts and retention ask:

1) SOC 2 mapping (CC6/CC7):
   - Evidence artifacts: change logs (git), deployment runbooks, incident postmortems (6 months), and config drift reports.
   - Owners: Aditya -> deployment runbooks & infra config; Marcus -> monitoring/ops logs; Naomi -> evidence packaging and documentation.
2) SIG/CAIQ:
   - Action: mark all Data Protection items as "requires evidence" except for a couple of non-applicable SaaS controls. Prepare a self-attest matrix for IAM controls (Identity provider screenshots, SSO config).
3) Retention/DPA:
   - Default eval retention: 180 days (meets Pioneer ask) but implement per-account retention flag to extend to audit windows (requires DPA addendum + customer-signed request).

Proposed internal sprint: 2-week evidence sprint starting 2026-12-20, followed by a 1-week review with Pioneer security. That gets us to a close window end of Jan 7 for initial acceptance if approvals are quick.

No external CC on this message — internal ops plan only.

Marcus
Principal Infrastructure Engineer
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@pioneerhealth.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, legal@pioneerhealth.com
Date: 2026-12-15T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft and operational runbook — proposed acceptance timeline + evidence table

Sarah —

Appreciate the SIG clarifications. Attached is an updated acceptance table and a proposed timeline that aligns with the internal sprint Marcus outlined (redwood-evidence-columns.csv). Key changes:

- Retention: we’ll default to 180 days for evaluation data. We’ve added a documented process to request an extension for audit purposes; that process is: Pioneer files a retention extension request via the account portal -> Redwood legal reviews -> DPA addendum executed. We’ve captured who signs and SLA for turnaround (5 business days for initial review).
- SOC 2 CC6/CC7: we list the exact artifacts we’ll provide and the expected delivery dates (most are available at sprint end).
- SIG/CAIQ: we’ll provide a per-question disposition column (Evidence / Self-attest / N/A).

If Pioneer legal is comfortable with the proposed retention extension flow and signatory list, we can update the DPA redline and move to DocuSign. I’ve included a short set of escape hatches in the MAP for exceptional residency/escrow requests (we propose KMS-based escrow + region pin as an enterprise add-on).

Next steps proposed (short):
1) Pioneer legal to confirm retention extension workflow and signatory names by Fri 12/17.
2) Redwood runs evidence sprint 12/20–1/2 and delivers packaged evidence for review week of 1/3.
3) Final acceptance review week of 1/10; target close 1/14.

Attachments: redwood-evidence-columns.csv, updated-MAP-runbook-summary (inline)

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Head of Field Security Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Li <sarah.li@pioneerhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@pioneerhealth.com
Date: 2026-12-18T09:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP operational runbook — SOC2/SIG/DPA closure + retention escape hatches

Kimberly —

This looks good and thank you for the concrete timeline. A couple of small asks before we sign the DPA redline:

1) Can the retention extension approval path include a named Pioneer security approver (I’ll provide the contact today) so we don’t have to route every request to legal? That will speed audits.
2) For the escrow option: Pioneer prefers an HSM-based key escrow; can you confirm we can support a KMS+HSM pattern and a short statement for the addendum?

If you can fold those two items into the DPA redline we can get legal to sign and route the DocuSign. I’ll also upload the Pioneer contact for retention approvals to the HubSpot deal record.

DocuSign link (placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/placeholder/PH-DPA-2026

If we get the updated redline by EOD Friday (12/18) we’ll target signature next week.

Thanks —
Sarah
Director, Platform Security
Pioneer Health
